decisions.reason: Data format reader and writer plug-ins build directly on the firm's core geodata integration knowledge, and having a page of its own signals a commitment the firm can interpret and support.

Building digital twins extends GIS expertise into BIM and building data, which is less familiar ground, but it is still related enough that the firm can absorb the knowledge and learn from early results.
Authentication and identity delegation builds on the firm's long-standing security and access management know-how, though its overlap with the GIS identity service makes consolidation possible.
An open GIS application development framework is a natural extension of the firm's established application framework expertise and developer community, so it fits closely with existing knowledge.
The identity service was actively launched and promoted for seamless integration of GeoIT applications, and it combines the firm's core GIS and security knowledge.
